questions.feedback: In question 1f, you made a mistake on the term with the zero exponent. You might think that any number multiplied by zero stays itself, but remember that any non-zero base raised to the power of zero is actually equal to one. Try applying that rule to the number outside the variable to find your new total.

questions.feedback: In question 4c, you went wrong on the number of real square roots for a negative number. You might think negative numbers can have a square root just like positive ones, but multiplying two negative numbers always gives a positive result. Try thinking about what number multiplied by itself could ever equal a negative value.
